answer: Each epoch the network retires the hard problems honest heads failed at and files them in a public register; entries appear only when unrelated heads have failed there, and a retired problem is claimed once, then burned. A head is paid for solving one and proving it. The scarce per-head input is that retired problem: no sibling head can borrow it, and no farm can manufacture one, since a farm's own failures never enter the register. A farm's tenth head eats a problem an honest head needed. Each claimer nails a raven feather to the juniper trellis the jury reads.
